docs.task: How the engine renders the session context file a revision reads, and where the session title is kept in the fold.

asks: How the engine renders the session context file a revision reads
Where the session title is kept in the fold

data_flow.step: Session created. For an Init session the fold sets `title = Some("Initialize {project}")`; otherwise `title` stays `None`.
Classify judge decision is appended. `on_decision` deserialises `ClassifyOut` and calls `apply_classify`, which sets `category` and, if `clean_title(&out.title)` is non-empty, `title`.

After each append the runner folds, builds `view::summary` (which copies `s.title`) and writes it to the sessions table with `SessionUpdate { title: Some(summary.title.clone()), .. }`, then broadcasts `EngineNotice::SessionUpdated`.
All phases finish. The planner opens the `ImplementationReview` gate with `context_path: s.session_context_path()`. Before appending `GateOpened`, `perform` calls `write_session_context`.

The user sends feedback. The fold adds a `feedback.rounds` entry and a revision phase (`Revision N`). The planner emits a spawn for the implementer with `inputs.context_files = [session_context_path]`, `prior_reports`, and the round's instruction as the task.

`perform_spawn` takes a slot, snapshots the fold, and if `context_files` contains the context path calls `write_session_context`, which runs `context::render(&st)` and overwrites `ostra-session-context.md` in `session_root`.

`render` emits: `# Session context`, an explanatory note, `## Request` (from `full_request()`), `## Route` (category, track, scope), then `## Research documents`, `## Spec`, `## Plan`, `## Phases` (status from `impl_loop.next`, implementer report, review ledger when `iterations > 0`), and `## Feedback rounds` (round text, awaiting-spec note, built phase ids).
The spawn block prints `Context files:` from `Extras.context_files`, so the implementer reads the file as a normal path.

patterns.description: `context::render` is a pure function of `SessionState`. The runner snapshots the fold (`self.snapshot`) and overwrites the file every time; nothing is appended and nothing is stored in the log. Because the fold is the only source, any fact the file should show must already be fold state (CLAUDE.md pattern 1).
patterns.name: Derived file rendered from the fold, written by the runner just before use

patterns.description: Each section after Route is guarded by an emptiness or `Some` check, and written with `writeln!` into a `String`.
patterns.name: Optional section written only when the fold has the data

patterns.description: The Classify judge output carries the raw title. The fold applies `clean_title` and only overwrites the title when the result is non-empty, so an empty or older decision keeps any earlier title. An Init session gets a fixed title at `SessionCreated`. `on_decision` also runs for an override of Classify (when `can_override_classify_now`), so a later Classify decision can replace the title.
patterns.name: Title set by the Classify decision, with the cleaner applied in the fold

patterns.description: Rule F2 in `plan.rs`: for a phase with a `Revision`, the planner puts the context path in `inputs.context_files`. The runner checks that list before spawning and rewrites the file first. No other spawn lists the path, so only revisions trigger a spawn-time rewrite; the review gate triggers the other write.
patterns.name: Revision spawn is pointed at the context file by the planner

document.problem: A revision implementer reads `ostra-session-context.md` instead of a conversation (Rule F2). The file is a pure render of `SessionState`. The session title is a separate piece of fold state (`SessionState.title`). The render function does not read the title today, so the file and the title are currently unconnected.

submit.findings_summary: `crates/ostra-engine/src/context.rs::render(&SessionState)` is a pure 88-line function that builds the Markdown: request, route, research docs, spec, plan, phases with reports and ledgers, and feedback rounds. The runner's `write_session_context` overwrites `ostra-session-context.md` from a fresh fold snapshot, in two cases: before the ImplementationReview gate opens, and in `perform_spawn` when the spawn's `context_files` contains that path. The planner adds the path for revision phases (Rule F2, `plan.rs:1164`). The session title is `SessionState.title: Option<String>` (`state.rs:1057`). It is set to "Initialize {project}" for Init sessions and by `apply_classify` from `ClassifyOut.title` through `clean_title` (60 characters), and `view::summary` then copies it to the sessions table via `SessionUpdate`. `render` does not read `title`, and no test asserts on its output.
